remarks: Don't miss your chance to own this two-family home or transform it into a single-family residence. Upper level (Unit 1) includes a walk-in porch, 1 bedroom, full bathroom, dining room, office, den and comfortable living room with a fireplace. This unit also has a washer/dryer hookup. The lower level (Unit 2) offers 2 bedrooms, full bathroom, living room, and home office or playroom.  Additional features include separate thermostats for each unit. Perfect for investors or owner-occupants. The property sits on a 0.13 lot, so you can enjoy a private outdoor space. Conveniently located near downtown Greenwich, train stations and I-95, making this home a must see!
